checks.name: saved request opens with its exact question and no draft
draft response loss retries once and reload shows the persisted value
saved initial answer with lost HTTP response remains retryable and clears only its draft
correction response loss retries the same immutable version and survives reload
stale HTTP draft, foreign case and foreign origin cannot overwrite the saved answer
two independent HTTP clients retry one correction without duplicate versions
an open request expires in the displayed thread without manual reload or hydration errors
request retries preserve case/payment and all three original/corrected versions

scope: Seeded QA sessions; hosted request draft/answer/correction UI, HTTP and isolated DEV DB. No OTP, provider, real payment or canonical correction application proof.
